item.title: City to hold discussions on campus redevelopment plan
item.description: The city of Baraboo and Sauk County will host two public input sessions to gather countywide feedback on the Baraboo Sauk County Campus Redevelopment Plan. These sessions aim to involve county residents in shaping the future of the 63-acre campus…

item.title: Reedsburg hospital earns award
item.description: Reedsburg Area Medical Center received the 2026 Excellence in Health Care Quality and Patient Safety Award from the Wisconsin Hospital Association during their Quality and Patient Safety Awards ceremony on Feb. 4 in Madison.

item.title: Parkinson's Support Group to meet Monday
item.description: The Baraboo Parkinson’s Support Group will host its monthly meeting at 2 p.m. Monday at First Congregational United Church of Christ, 131 Sixth Ave., Baraboo. Open to all. Building is handicapped accessible.

item.title: Sauk Democrats to meet Thursday
item.description: The Sauk County Democratic Party, S4066 Highway BD, Suite 8, Baraboo, will meet with a potluck dinner at 6 p.m. Thursday followed by a short business meeting. Baraboo Police Chief Justin Carloni will speak at 6:30 p.m.
